question: Name the first Indian woman who became the President of the Indian National Congress.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sarojini Naidu**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Sarojini Naidu** was an Indian independence activist, poet, and politician.
 
• She became the first Indian woman to be the President of the Indian National Congress in 1925.
 
• Sarojini Naidu was also known as the **'Nightingale of India'** for her contributions to poetry.
 
• She played a significant role in the Civil Disobedience Movement and the Quit India Movement.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Rani Velu Nachiyar**

 
 
• Rani Velu Nachiyar was the first Indian queen to wage war against the British colonial rule in India.
 
• She ruled over the kingdom of Sivaganga in Tamil Nadu.
 
• She formed alliances with several neighboring kingdoms to fight against the British.
 
• She is remembered for her bravery and strategic acumen in resisting colonial rule.
 
 
 
• **Annie Besant**
 
 
• Annie Besant was a British socialist, theosophist, women's rights activist, writer, orator, and supporter of Indian self-rule.
 
• She was the first woman president of the Indian National Congress in 1917.
 
• She founded the Home Rule League and played a significant role in India's struggle for independence.
 
• She was also an advocate for social reforms and education.
 
 
 
• **Sarala Devi Chaudhurani**
 
 
• Sarala Devi Chaudhurani was an Indian freedom fighter, poet, and educator.
 
• She was the niece of Rabindranath Tagore and an active participant in the Indian independence movement.
 
• She established the Bharat Stree Mahamandal, the first women's organization in India.
 
• She was a prominent figure in promoting women's education and empowerment.
